title: Touch Move!!!!
transcript: My opponent and I shake hands, and the game starts. I play d4, he plays f5, and I reach for my bishop as I play the London against almost everything, and I do touch it with my fingers. I try to change move, but then realize that which means that I have to move that bishop. My opponent shakes his head as if to say, "Oh, I don't mind." But, it's too late now, and I am out of theory on move two. But, despite that, I keep playing, and eventually my opponent plays a blunder. This allows me to take the knight, make him take with the bishop, lure the king into a checkable square, and then deliver this queen fork of the king [music] and bishop. The opponent is understandably disappointed, and I start to really lock in. With an advantage like this one, I have no intention of losing. So, I make sure that I don't waste time thinking about obvious moves, and I gradually create a checkmating net around the black king. I push this knight closer. My opponent defends against the rook check, and now I [music] bring this pawn closer. This is a checkmate in one threat. He misses it, and so I deliver a simple checkmate, securing my first ever over 2000 blitz rating.
